title: Shared test coverage for cook mode
description: Add and run the feature's consolidated automated coverage across CookbookCore and app-layer view behavior, including the new step helper, cook-mode entry behavior, and cook-mode phase/navigation structure.
acceptance_criteria: CookbookCore tests cover empty, single, repeated, and ordered multi-ingredient cases for `Step.ingredientIndices()`.
App tests cover cook-mode entry state, gather-to-step transition, navigation boundary enablement, and done-page indexing.
Relevant existing or new tests cover the `Cook now` action gating behavior on the recipe detail bottom bar.
Documented test execution includes package-level `swift test` and the relevant app test target, or records any environment blocker if execution is not possible.
